purpose: Test whether richer source sensor context contains diagnostic information missing from the 10-channel common contract. Separate source-only experiment, not a replacement or transfer claim.
channels: Return Air Mass Flow Rate in the Mixing Box (kg/s)
Measured AHU Supply Air Duct Static Pressure (Pa)
AHU Supply Air Duct Static Pressure Setpoint (Pa)
AHU Outdoor Air Wet Bulb Temperature (°K)
excluded: true positions, labels, scenario identifiers, dates and time values as model inputs
alignment: Original window IDs, row ranges and train/validation partitions unchanged. File identities only join rows; never features.
limitations: Simulated source channels; sensor availability, measurement quality and semantics at target sites are not established. Any larger gain is not comparable as an algorithm-only improvement. No deployment from this script.
